visual_goal: Show one reservation counting in different metrics in different periods: created in February, retained in the February cohort at check-in, stayed and honored in August.
prompt: A horizontal timeline ribbon running left to right with three dated stops marked by pins: '14 Feb' at the left, '2 Aug' in the middle and '9 Aug' at the right. A small suitcase token travels along the ribbon from the first pin to the last. Above each pin, the metric jars it fills, each jar a rounded container with a short label: above '14 Feb' two jars, 'Created' and 'Net'; above '2 Aug' one jar, 'Cohort retained'; above '9 Aug' two jars, 'Stayed' and 'Honored'. One thin arrow from each pin up into each of its jars, five arrows in total. Under the ribbon, a soft bracket spans from February to August labeled 'one reservation'.
alt: A timeline with pins at 14 February, 2 August and 9 August; one suitcase travels along it, filling Created and Net jars in February, a Cohort retained jar at check-in and Stayed and Honored jars in August.

visual_goal: Show marketplace intelligence as layers: behavioral and business events arrive separately, become owned data products and governed metrics read by every consumer, while regulatory exports read the data products directly.
prompt: A left-to-right layered flow. At the far left, two separate sources stacked vertically: a phone and laptop labeled 'Clients' on top, with one arrow right into a small gate labeled 'Consent gate'; below, a stack of database cylinders labeled 'Systems of record'. One arrow from the gate and one arrow from the cylinders both go right into a horizontal pipe labeled 'Event backbone'. One arrow from the pipe into a wide lake-like storage block labeled 'Lakehouse'. One arrow from the lakehouse into a shelf of neat boxed packages labeled 'Data products'. One arrow from the shelf into a measuring-instrument panel labeled 'Metric layer'. From the metric layer three arrows fan out right to three small unlabeled icons: a boardroom chart, a beaker and a storefront. One separate arrow goes from the 'Data products' shelf straight down to a sealed envelope labeled 'Regulators'.
alt: Clients pass a consent gate and systems of record feed an event backbone into a lakehouse, then owned data products, then a metric layer that fans out to reporting, experiments and partners, while regulatory exports read the data products directly.

visual_goal: Show partner insight built from the same data products as internal metrics, passed through privacy and fairness checks, stored in one read model and served identically to every partner surface.
prompt: A left-to-right flow. At the far left, three stacked boxed packages, each with one arrow right into a single workshop box labeled 'Insight builder': 'Partner performance', 'Market demand' and 'Ranking log'. From the insight builder one arrow right into a filter screen with a small shield labeled 'Privacy checks'. From the filter one arrow right into a database cylinder labeled 'Read model'. From the read model three arrows fan out right to three endpoints, each showing the same small bar chart: a laptop labeled 'Extranet', a plug icon labeled 'API' and an unlabeled account manager at a desk. The same small bar chart appears identically on all three endpoints.
alt: Partner performance, market demand and ranking log feed an insight builder, then privacy checks, then one read model that serves the same chart to the extranet, the API and an account manager.
